title: RNA-seq of peripheral blood eosinophils in patients with allergic asthma treated with inhaled glucocorticoid
description: RNA-seq of peripheral blood eosinophils in patients with allergic asthma treated with inhaled glucocorticoid provides high-resolution transcriptome data, which provide a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of allergic asthma.
